reward_rules.description: 5% cashback on Flipkart; maximum cashback that can be earned in a statement quarter is INR 4,000 on Flipkart.
7.5% cashback on Myntra; maximum cashback of INR 4,000 per statement quarter.
5% cashback on Cleartrip; maximum cashback that can be earned in a statement quarter is INR 4,000 on Cleartrip.

gotchas: The revision notice says there is no change to excluded spend categories and lists cashback exclusions as Utility & Telecom, Education, Rent, Wallet load, Government services, Insurance, Gold & Jewellery, Fuel, Financial Institutions, Cash advances and Repayments. It also says spend-based fee waiver exclusions are Rent and Wallet load. [axis_flipkart_revision_2025-06.pdf p.1-2]
Annual fee is INR 500 for FLIPKART AXIS BANK_Credit Card, waived on spends of INR 3,50,000 in the preceding card anniversary year. [axis_common_mitc.pdf p.2-10]

There is no separate base cashback rate stated for other spends in the cited documents; treated as 0% for spends not covered by the named reward rules or exclusions. [axis_flipkart_revision_2025-06.pdf p.1-2]

The card documents use a statement-quarter cap for Flipkart and Cleartrip cashback. The revision gives INR 4,000 per statement quarter for each merchant; the example shows Flipkart and Cleartrip each capped separately. [axis_flipkart_revision_2025-06.pdf p.1]

Spend-based fee waiver exclusions are only Rent and Wallet load in the revision notice; the annual fee waiver spends are therefore based on eligible spends excluding those categories. [axis_flipkart_revision_2025-06.pdf p.1-2]
The base MITC fee tables and surcharge tables are generic Axis Bank tables; the fee extracted here is only from the row naming FLIPKART AXIS BANK_Credit Card exactly. [axis_common_mitc.pdf p.2-10]

## Revision of FLIPKART AXIS BANK Credit Card Terms and Conditions

While you continue to enjoy the benefits on your FLIPKART AXIS BANK Credit Card, effective 20th June 2025, the following revisions will be applicable on your credit card:

1. Changes in features and benefits

- You will be able to enjoy increased cashback of 7.5% (increased from earlier cashback of 1%) on Myntra, with a maximum cashback of INR 4,000 per statement quarter.

- You will continue to earn 5% cashback on Flipkart and Cleartrip; however, the maximum cashback that can be earned per statement quarter is INR 4,000 on Flipkart and INR 4,000 on Cleartrip.

- Statement quarter is defined basis your statement date. For e.g. if your statement date is 15th of every month, then:

- 1st Quarter:16th March-15th June

- 2nd Quarter: 16th June-15th September

- 3rd Quarter:16th September-15th December

- 4th Quarter:16th December-15th March

- Cashback earned for purchases during a statement month will be credited within 3 days prior to the next statement generation date. E.g. if the statement date is 15th April, cashback earned for transactions made between 16th March- 15th April will be credited on 12th May.

2. Changes to the spend exclusion approach for reward earns and spend based fee waiver calculation

- There is no change to the spend categories excluded from earning rewards and spend based fee waiver calculation. However, to simplify, such transactions will now be identified based on the spend category (Utility & Telecom, Rent, Wallet load, etc.) rather than the assigned 4-digit Merchant Category Code (MCC).

- Excluded spend categories:

- For cashback: Transactions made on Utility & Telecom, Education, Rent, Wallet load, Government services, Insurance, Gold & Jewellery, Fuel, Financial Institutions, Cash advances and Repayments.

- For spend based fee waiver calculation: Transactions made on Rent and Wallet load.

For more details, please visit axisbank.com/mitnc.
